full_name: Section-Aware Group-Isolated Evidence Fusion for Fraudulent Job Detection

branches.label: Lexical
branches.role: Word and character TF-IDF over section-tagged text, scored by a linear SVM.

branches.label: Structural
branches.role: 56 structural signals — missingness, length, punctuation, salary and risk language.

branches.label: Semantic
branches.role: Windowed MiniLM embeddings pooled per section, plus cross-section coherence.

branches.label: Campaign
branches.role: Template novelty and group-safe fraud risk against known posting campaigns.
